qualification.education_qualification: Degree in Chemical Engineering, Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Degree in Mining/Mechanical/Chemical Engineering
qualification.details: Manager - Chemical (Coal Gasification): Degree in Chemical Engineering from a reputed institution with minimum 5 years experience in gasification, refinery, petrochemical, fertilizer, chemical or industrial gas plant operations. Manager - Mechanical (Coal Gasification): Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a reputed institution with minimum 5 years experience in gasification, refinery, petrochemical, fertilizer, chemical or thermal power plant. DGM - Coal Gasification: Degree in Engineering (Mining/Mechanical/Chemical) from a reputed institution with minimum 10 years experience in gasification, refinery, petrochemical, fertilizer, chemical projects with at least 2 years leading a plant, mine or project site.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website:https://www.gmdcltd.com/ . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for GMDC Recruitment 2026 is 03-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GMDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for various managerial and DGM posts in the Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for GMDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for GMDC Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Manager posts?
faq.answer: For Manager - Chemical, a Degree in Chemical Engineering is required. For Manager - Mechanical, a Degree in Mechanical Engineering is necessary. Both require relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the DGM - Coal Gasification post?
faq.answer: The DGM - Coal Gasification post requires a Degree in Engineering (Mining/Mechanical/Chemical) with a minimum of 10 years of experience in relevant projects.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for GMDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for GMDC Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the posts announced in GMDC Recruitment 2026 will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for the positions in GMDC Recruitment 2026 is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the GMDC located?
faq.answer: GMDC is located in Gujarat, with the city of Ahmedabad mentioned in the context of this recruitment, and the pincode 380052.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for GMDC Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form and submit it by post.
